pkill -f "http[.]server 8123" 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 1
pgrep -af "http.server" 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo "remaining-httpd-rc=$?"

import urllib.request
try:
    urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8123/acc.html',timeout=3)

    print('server down as expected:', type(e).__name__)
PY
rm -rf ../work/acc
exit 0
